STOCKWISE SMART INVENTORY

Stockwise Smart Inventory

A simple guide to the features, screens and technologies behind Stockwise. Captured with the cleaning-products inventory on 22 October 2026.

OVERVIEW

Stockwise Smart Inventory

Stockwise helps a single-store business manage products, stock, suppliers and purchasing in one web application. This guide shows the main screens using a cleaning-products demonstration inventory.

The dashboard brings stock value, units on hand, low-stock alerts and open purchase orders together. A sales chart shows recorded demand and a baseline forecast for the next 14 days.

INVENTORY

Find and manage your products

Keep product names, SKUs, barcodes, categories, suppliers, selling prices and unit costs in a central catalogue. Search by name, SKU or barcode, then filter by category, supplier or stock status.

Add, edit and delete product records from the catalogue. CSV tools support inventory and transaction exports, plus product import. Stock quantities change through receipts, sales, adjustments or stocktakes.

EVERYDAY WORK

Make changes in clear popup forms

Add and edit records in popup dialogs while keeping the current screen in view. Product forms include unit cost, selling price, minimum stock and supplier assignment.

Record sales, receipts and signed stock adjustments from Stock movements. Barcode lookup can select a product for a movement. Stocktake compares a physical count with the recorded balance. History records changes for review.

REORDERING

Plan and receive replenishment

Review demand, days of cover, reorder points, outstanding orders and suggested units together. Type the quantity you want in Order quantity, then choose Create order to use that amount.

Purchase orders track ordered, received and remaining units, plus an expected delivery date. Receive a full delivery or part of an order as stock arrives. Supplier lead times support replenishment estimates.

Suggestions use recent sales and supplier lead times. They are baseline estimates and do not model seasonality or lost demand during stockouts.

REPORTS

See sales and known cost profit

Choose a date range to view revenue, units sold, known cost and known-cost profit. The product table ranks best sellers and shows units without a recorded cost. Export the report for further review.

Known cost is the recorded unit cost of sold units. Known-cost profit is the revenue from those costed units minus their recorded cost. It excludes operating expenses and taxes; sales missing a cost are excluded from the profit calculation.

ASK AI

Ask questions and review stock actions

Use prompts to explore inventory, sales, profit and replenishment, or prepare a stock change or purchase order. Review the proposed action before confirming it.

Demo mode uses built-in cleaning-product scenarios with no API credits or changes to the main inventory. Live AI uses the backend OpenAI connection and requires available API credits. The API key stays on the server.

TECHNOLOGY

How the application is built

The browser interface sends requests to the backend API. The backend validates them and reads or updates PostgreSQL. The OpenAI connection stays on the server.

LayerTechnologyPurpose
FrontendReact 19 and TypeScriptBuilds the browser screens, forms and interactions.
Build and stylingVite 7 and CSSDevelops and bundles the interface; CSS defines its layout and appearance.
ChartsRecharts 3Displays recorded sales and the demand forecast.
BackendNode.js, Express 5 and TypeScriptProvides the JSON API and applies inventory and purchasing rules.
DatabasePostgreSQL with the pg driverStores products, suppliers, movements, orders and change history.
Validation and jobsZod and node-cronValidates incoming data and runs scheduled inventory jobs.
AI integrationOpenAI Responses APISupports live AI requests through server-side tools and reviewed action proposals.

A short showcase walkthrough

  1. Start with the Overview metrics and low-stock alerts.
  2. Search for Glass Cleaner in Inventory and open the Edit popup.
  3. Show the editable Order quantity field in Reordering.
  4. Explain known cost and known-cost profit in Reports.
  5. Use Ask AI Demo mode to prepare a simulated stock receipt and review its confirmation card.

The current showcase runs as a local single-store workspace. Demo mode is simulated; Live AI needs available API credits.
